title: Word Roots · Q3 W09 D03
objective: Identify a base word, or root, in common related words.
introduction: Milo hears the base word call inside called! 🐱✨ Find the base word hiding in related words.

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: Call is the base word, and called is made from it, so the pair shares a root.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'called'?
items.explanation: Called is call with -ed added, so call is the base word.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'call'?
items.explanation: Called is made from the root call by adding -ed.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: "cat — dog" names two animals, not a word family. The other pairs share a base word and a related word.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'builder'?
items.explanation: Builder is build with -er added, so build is the base word.
